scores.reasons: Site works and reviews are strong but the missing schedule and pricing is a direct revenue leak; a single academy with kids and adult programs and 200+ reviews is a solid payer; fixing schedule/pricing and adding booking is quick; most findings came from live pages, review counts from aggregators.

caveats: Google review counts are not displayed in the limited Maps view available without sign-in, so ratings are recorded but counts are either omitted or taken from third-party aggregators where noted.
Review text was not audited in depth; operations signals come from on-site evidence (forms, booking links, published policies) rather than complaint mining.
Four Pebbles' opening date is inferred from a local events calendar listing a November 14-15, 2026 grand opening, two days after this research date.

Acupuncture Center of Wellness' Google identity is ambiguous: searching its phone returns a partial match located in South River with no reviews, while a different same-name business at 786 King Georges Rd outranks it. This needs owner confirmation before outreach.
data_gaps: Google Maps was used without sign-in, so review counts, photo counts and full hours fields could not be inspected for any business.
Vital Balance's Unified Practice booking portal showed a Cloudflare 'security verification' interstitial and was not bypassed, so the booking flow beyond that screen is unverified.
Sunlite shares suite 200 at 190 Route 18 with a separately listed 'Hope Acupuncture and Wellness'; the relationship (suite-mate, successor or duplicate listing) is unknown.
Full review-site pages (Yelp, Birdeye) were not opened in depth; those review counts come from search-result summaries.
Fit-Spot's closed status is taken from its Google listing ('Permanently closed'); there is no owner-side confirmation.
